```{r}
pop1980 = read.csv("rb1980_pop_sexo.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 3)

pop2010 = read.csv("rb2010_pop_sexo.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 3)

mort1980 = read.csv("rb1980_mortes_idade.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 14)

mort2010 = read.csv("rb2010_mortes_idade.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 13)

cens1980 = read.csv("rb1980_cens.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 14)

cens2010 = read.csv("rb2010_cens.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 13)
```

```{r}
TMI1980 = mort1980[1,2]/cens1980[1,2] * 1000
TMI2010 = mort2010[1,2]/cens2010[1,2] * 1000
```

```{r}
TM51980 = (mort1980[1,2] + mort1980[2,2])/(cens1980[1,2] + cens1980[2,2]) * 1000
TM52010 = (mort2010[1,2] + mort2010[2,2])/(cens2010[1,2] + cens2010[2,2]) * 1000
```

```{r}
TBM1980 = mort1980[14,2]/cens1980[14,2] * 1000
TBM2010 = mort2010[13,2]/cens2010[13,2] * 1000
```

```{r}
TEM1980 = mort1980[1:12,2]/cens1980[1:12,2]
TEM2010 = mort2010[1:12,2]/cens2010[1:12,2]
```

```{r}
data.frame(ANO = c(1980, 2010), TMI = c(TMI1980, TMI2010), TM5 = c(TM51980, TM52010), TBM = c(TBM1980, TBM2010))

data.frame(TEM1980, TEM2010)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
Faixa_Etaria = c("Menor 1 ano", "1 a 4 anos", "5 a 9 anos", "10 a 14 anos", 
                 "15 a 19 anos", "20 a 29 anos", "30 a 39 anos", "40 a 49 anos", 
                 "50 a 59 anos", "60 a 69 anos", "70 a 79 anos", "80 anos e mais")

df_mort1980 = data.frame(mort1980[1:12,1] |> unlist(), log(mort1980[1:12,2]/cens1980[1:12,2]))
df_mort2010 = data.frame(mort2010[1:12,1] |> unlist(), log(mort2010[1:12,2]/cens2010[1:12,2]))
colnames(df_mort1980) = c("X1", "Y1")
colnames(df_mort2010) = c("X2", "Y2")
df_mort1980$Ano = "1980"
df_mort2010$Ano = "2010"
df_mort1980$X1 = factor(df_mort1980$X1, levels = Faixa_Etaria)
df_mort2010$X2 = factor(df_mort2010$X2, levels = Faixa_Etaria)

ordem_cores = c("1980" = "#00BA38", "2010" = "#A020F0")

plot1 = ggplot()+
  geom_point(data = df_mort1980, aes(x = X1, y = Y1, color = Ano), size = 5)+
  geom_line(data = df_mort1980, aes(x = 1:12, y = Y1, color = Ano), linewidth = 2)+
  geom_point(data = df_mort2010, aes(x = X2, y = Y2, color = Ano), size = 5)+
  geom_line(data = df_mort2010, aes(x = 1:12, y = Y2, color = Ano), size = 2)+
  labs(x = "Idade", y = "Log da Taxa Bruta de Mortalidade",
       title = "Comparação das Taxas Brutas de Mortalidade por Idade em 1980 e 2010 no Rio Branco - AC")+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(name = "Ano",values = ordem_cores)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12,
                                   angle = -45, hjust = 0),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

plot1
```

```{r}
cens_sexo1980 = read.csv("rb1980_censo_sexo.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 14)

cens_sexo2010 = read.csv("rb2010_censo_sexo.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 13)

mort_sexo1980 = read.csv("rb1980_mort_sexo.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 14)

mort_sexo2010 = read.csv("rb2010_mort_sexo.csv", skip = 5,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 13)
```

```{r}
TEM1980F = as.numeric(mort_sexo1980[1:12,3])/cens_sexo1980[1:12,3] * 1000
TEM1980M = mort_sexo1980[1:12,2]/cens_sexo1980[1:12,2] * 1000

TEM2010F = as.numeric(mort_sexo2010[1:12,3])/cens_sexo2010[1:12,3] * 1000
TEM2010M = mort_sexo2010[1:12,2]/cens_sexo2010[1:12,2] * 1000

df_tem1980 = data.frame(TEM1980F, TEM1980M)
df_tem2010 = data.frame(TEM2010F, TEM2010M)

df_tem1980
df_tem2010
```

```{r}
brasil_censo = read.csv("censo2010.csv", skip = 4,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 12)

brasil_mortes = read.csv("morte2010.csv", skip = 4,
                   sep = ";", header = FALSE, nrows = 12)
```

```{r}
ObitosEsperados1980 = TEM1980*brasil_censo[,3]

TBM1980PADRAO = sum(ObitosEsperados1980)/sum(brasil_censo[,3]) * 1000

ObitosEsperados2010 = TEM2010*brasil_censo[,3]

TBM2010PADRAO = sum(ObitosEsperados2010)/sum(brasil_censo[,3]) * 1000

data.frame(ANO = c(1980, 2010), TMI = c(TMI1980, TMI2010),
           TM5 = c(TM51980, TM52010), TBM = c(TBM1980, TBM2010),
           TBMPADRAO = c(TBM1980PADRAO, TBM2010PADRAO))
```

```{r}
df_padrao1980 = df_mort1980
df_padrao2010 = df_mort2010

df_padrao1980$Y1 = log(ObitosEsperados1980/brasil_censo[,3])
df_padrao2010$Y1 = log(ObitosEsperados2010/brasil_censo[,3])

plot2 = ggplot()+
  geom_point(data = df_padrao1980, aes(x = X1, y = Y1, color = Ano), size = 5)+
  geom_line(data = df_padrao1980, aes(x = 1:12, y = Y1, color = Ano), linewidth = 2)+
  geom_point(data = df_padrao2010, aes(x = X2, y = Y2, color = Ano), size = 5)+
  geom_line(data = df_padrao2010, aes(x = 1:12, y = Y2, color = Ano), size = 2)+
  labs(x = "Idade", y = "Log da Taxa Bruta de Mortalidade",
       title = "Comparação das Taxas Brutas de Mortalidade por Idade em 1980 e 2010 no Rio Branco - AC")+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(name = "Ano",values = ordem_cores)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12,
                                   angle = -45, hjust = 0),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

plot2
```
